svg.aria-label: 3 small isometric buildings on one base plate, linked by dashed paths: Pepprio, a restaurant with a striped awning and a service counter (restaurant order management, github.com/pepprio, pepprio.com); Pignelle, an agency under a gable roof with a for-sale board (tools for real estate agencies, github.com/Pignelle, pignelle.com); BenMacha, a workshop with a workbench, a screen and a lamp (personal workshop, github.com/BenMacha, benmacha.tn).
svg.title: Organizations and projects
svg.text: Fig. 1 — 3 buildings on one plate, one per organization, linked by paths.
